answer_1.quote: Open-ended text generation aims to craft fluent and coherent textual continuations of given prompts, laying foundations for various downstream applications such as writing assistance and story generation.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate generated text with both automatic and human evaluation. MAUVE score (the higher the better) measures the distribution similarity between the set of generated text and the set of gold reference. Coherence. We follow and approximate coherence by cosine similarity between the sentence embeddings of prompt x pre and generated continuation x cont : , where EMB(x) is the pre-trained SimCSE sentence embedding .

answer_4.quote: We ask Amazon Mechanical Turkers to read two continuations (A and B) of the same prompt, and choose the more fluent/coherent continuation or decide they are similar.
answer_4.guideline: Turkers choose the more fluent/coherent continuation or indicate similarity.
